name: zoho-crm
description:
Governed Zoho CRM for small teams and AI agents. Twenty-two commands across Leads, Contacts, Accounts, Deals and any custom module. Every write is held behind the airlock and sealed into a signed receipt.

WHO IT'S FOR: teams too small for a compliance function but regulated enough that 'who changed this client record, and who approved it' gets asked eventually. Also anyone giving an AI agent write access to a CRM.

THE PROBLEM: CRM has no undo. A wrong filter on a mass update rewrites 400 client records and there is no rollback, only a restore request. Zoho Flow and Zapier will both run that automation; neither can stop it, and neither records who authorised it.

TWELVE READS (no approval): verify_connection probes every scope and names any missing one plus the commands it blocks. describe_module returns every field including custom ones. search_records runs read-only COQL. list_records pages a module, get_record fetches one by id, list_users returns users and their ids. plan_update, plan_delete and plan_handover work out what a change would do without doing it. plan_rollback reports what undoing an applied change would restore. verify_ledger and audit_pack expose the local record of every change and every refusal.

TEN WRITES (preview then approve): apply_update, apply_delete, apply_handover and apply_rollback commit the matching plan, each refusing if the records moved since review. create_record and update_record work on any module, 100 per call. upsert_records inserts or updates against duplicate-check fields. delete_record moves to the recycle bin. convert_lead turns a Lead into a Contact and Account. add_note writes reasoning back onto a record.

PLAN THEN APPLY: an approval binds to the inputs a human saw, not to the records they point at. Approve a diff over 80 records, someone edits nine while it sits there, and the write lands on state nobody reviewed. Each plan snapshots the state it will change and fingerprints it; the matching apply re-reads, re-hashes, and refuses if anything moved. Scans page to completion, so a set is never half-reported. Applied changes are recorded in a hash-chained local ledger, so plan_rollback can restore prior values and audit_pack can show every refusal.

RELIABILITY: Zoho reports partial failure with HTTP 200, so a batch where 3 of 50 fail still looks successful. Every write returns succeeded, failed and per-record errors. Writes are never auto-retried after a server error, since Zoho has no idempotency key. Setup and scopes: see README. contest:2026Q3
